questions.q: How did people carry their umbrellas in this city?
options: Upside down and low, like baskets
Two at once, one above and one below

questions.q: What had the flower seller done with her stall?
options: Turned it over, buckets hanging mouth-down so the tulips could drink on the way up
Covered it with a glass roof
Floated it on ropes above the street

questions.q: What rose out of the last puddle before it vanished?
options: Everything it had reflected — a sunset, a flock of geese, one slow airplane
A cloud of tiny silver fish
The morning's newspaper, page by page
